cause: DWM requested DXGI_DDI_PRESENT_FLAGS.Flip (value 2), no destination, subresource 0, interval 1. The UMD accepted only Blt (value 1) and returned E_INVALIDARG before calling PresentCb. DXGI reported device removed and discarded the swapchain.
cleanup: Both devices and packages removed successfully. The finite observer stopped after finding the rejection, so the concurrent 45-second topology-only observer later reported the removed monitor; that is expected teardown, not a new activation failure.
fix_under_test: Forward pure flips for runtime-owned shared PRESENT allocations to the actual DXGI PresentCb. Preserve real HRESULT, opaque context and allocation/context ownership. Reject combinations, unsupported intervals and private allocations.
